transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

Well… I guess I came in because people keep saying I’m “not acting right,” and I don’t want to cause trouble or anything. My husband thinks I’m making too much of it, and some people at the warehouse are acting like I’m crazy, but… I know they’ve been watching what I do.

It’s like they keep track of my moves, and the pallet counts get changed around so it makes me look bad. I’m pretty sure it’s to keep me from getting that supervisor spot. I know that probably sounds… I don’t know, but that’s what’s been happening.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is around?

Um… sometimes, yeah. Not all the time or anything. Like if I’m in an aisle at work, or even at home folding clothes, I’ll hear a man’s voice pretty clear, like he’s right there, saying, “Nicole, check it again.” But then nobody’s near me. I know that sounds bad… I’m not trying to be dramatic.
Have there been times when you felt unusually energetic and needed much less sleep than usual?

Yeah… I mean, sometimes. Not in a bad way, I don’t think. There have been stretches, like maybe a week or so, where I only sleep maybe three hours, and I’ll wake up before my alarm and feel like I’m fine, like I don’t really need more rest to get going. I know that probably sounds weird, but at the time it feels like I’m just ready to start the day.
During those times when you slept only a few hours, did you also feel unusually up or unusually irritable?

I guess… yeah, a little. I mean, some days I feel really fired up, like I can get everything done and nobody can slow me down. It doesn’t feel bad in the moment.

But then if my husband asks me one small thing, like about the kids or my schedule, I can snap at him. Like I take it as him trying to control me, even if maybe he’s just asking. I don’t want to sound awful saying that.
Have you had a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?

I… I don’t know if I’d say it was that much, like two whole weeks. I get down sometimes, sure, but I don’t really keep track of it that way. Most of the day, nearly every day… I’m not sure. I don’t want to answer wrong.
Have you ever heard that voice or felt watched during a time when your mood felt normal—not especially up, irritable, or depressed?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, I don’t want to make it sound worse than it was, because I wasn’t like… flying around or really depressed then. There were a few quieter weeks where I was sleeping more normal, and I wasn’t as wound up.

But I still heard that voice sometimes, telling me to check things. And I still had this feeling at work that the pallet counts were being changed on me, like somebody was doing it against me. I know that probably doesn’t sound right, but that’s how it felt then.
During those fired-up times, have you ever felt so unusually confident or powerful that other people said you were acting unlike yourself?

Maybe not “powerful,” exactly… I don’t want to make it sound dramatic. But yeah, there are days where I feel really fired up, like I can handle everything and nobody’s going to slow me down.

And I guess I can come off different then. Like if my husband asks me one little thing about the kids or my schedule, I snap at him, like he’s trying to control me. I know that probably doesn’t look like me being myself.
During those fired-up times, did you feel unusually important or gifted compared with other people?

Not like… I don’t think I’m better than people or anything. I wouldn’t want to say it that way.

It’s more like, on some days I get really fired up, like nobody can slow me down and I can handle everything. But then if my husband asks one small thing about the kids or my schedule, I snap at him, like he’s trying to control me. I know that doesn’t sound great… but that’s more what happens.
Have people told you that your speech was hard to follow or didn’t make sense?

Um… yeah, sometimes. I don’t think I’m trying to not make sense, but people have told me they can’t really follow me.

Like when I’m trying to explain what’s going on, I’ll start with the forklift sheets at work, and then somehow I’m talking about church signs, and then my husband’s tone… and I guess it all connects in my head, but other people say they don’t know what I’m getting at. I’m not sure if that’s what you mean, but… yeah, that has happened.
For at least one month, have the voice and the feeling that people were watching or sabotaging you been present most days?

Yeah… I mean, I don’t want to overstate it, but it’s been more than a month. The voices and that feeling like people are watching me, or messing with things… that’s been happening most days for maybe around eight months now.

I know that sounds like a lot. I just… that’s the honest answer.
During the past eight months, have the fired-up or irritable periods taken up most of that time?

Yeah… I think so. I don’t want to make it sound like I was just out of control the whole time, because I still tried to do what I had to do.

But if I’m being honest, more than half of these past months I’ve had those periods where I barely sleep and I’m taking on way too much, and then I get really irritated if somebody tries to slow me down or question me. So… yes, probably most of it, or at least more than half.
During one of those fired-up periods, were you ever hospitalized because of it?

I don’t… I don’t think so. Not hospitalized, no.

I mean, people were worried about me, and I probably wasn’t handling things great, but I didn’t get admitted anywhere for being fired-up like that. Is that what you mean?
During one of those fired-up periods, did it ever cause serious problems at work, at home, or with the law?

Um… yeah, I guess it did cause some problems. Not with the law or anything like that.

At work, my supervisors ended up taking me off the forklift and the more safety-sensitive stuff because I was getting too caught up in my counts and routines, and it was slowing the line down. I know they were probably just being careful.

And at home… my husband says he can’t really rely on me the way he used to. That’s hard to say, but… yeah, it has caused problems.
During those fired-up periods, did you ever become so out of touch with reality that you couldn’t function safely or had to be stopped by other people?

I mean… I don’t like saying “out of touch,” because I was still going to work and trying to keep up with everything.

But during those weeks when I was barely sleeping and pushing extra shifts, and doing boxing and church stuff too… I was hearing that man’s voice. And I was pretty sure people at the warehouse were setting me up.

I don’t know if that counts as not safe, but people did have to kind of pull me back or slow me down sometimes. Does that make sense?
Was there ever a period of at least 2 weeks when you were hearing the voice or felt people were watching you, while your mood was otherwise normal?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, it wasn’t like those really fired-up times.

There were a few quieter weeks where I was sleeping more normal, or closer to normal, and I wasn’t running around doing so much. But I was still hearing that voice sometimes, telling me to check things. And I still had this feeling that the pallet counts were being changed on me, like… against me.

I don’t know if that’s the kind of thing you mean, but my mood wasn’t really all high then. It was more just… normal, I guess.
